executiveSummary.immediateAnswer: Uretir is not missing more public pages first. It is missing production measurement, one authority-ready content cluster, verified source ingestion, and a persistent identity/workspace layer.
executiveSummary.productionReadyGap: Hosting, observability, consent-aware analytics, rollback ownership, and verified programme ingestion are not connected.
executiveSummary.next90Days: Prove one complete loop: validated demand → authority-ready cluster → universal discovery → grounded AI retrieval → measured return behavior.

scores.evidence: Editorial and topic-cluster contracts exist; no document currently passes the authority gate.
Universal publication-aware search exists; production telemetry and external search provider do not.
Entity and relationship contracts are validated; verified public entity depth remains limited.
Portfolio, trust contracts, and capability backlog exist; no live grounded answer service is enabled.
Fail-closed assessment and source model exist; verified programme ingestion is not connected.
Architecture is documented, but production identity, persistence, consent, and moderation are absent.
Repository quality and CI exist; hosting, observability, analytics, deployment, and rollback remain unapproved.
All personas have discovery entry points, but high-value tasks depend on data, identity, and workflow products.
